rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: Who Cares More?
card.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I kept twelve tickets from our trips. How many did you keep?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: None. I made you that album instead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And I kept it. Your care is safe because of mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Open it. I put all my tickets inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'm preserving both our collections. Let me get it a waterproof cover.

card.title: Who Cares More?
card.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll carry the heavier bag. I care more about your back.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let me take it for a while.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'd appear to care more about mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We could share it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if I take the side with the books.

card.title: Still a Good Sign
card.instruction: Treat every awkward or disappointing interaction as proof that the connection remains alive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our first dinner since the breakup, and you still groan at my waiter joke.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I hoped you'd retired it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You remembered. We've still got our little traditions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we eat in silence? I don't want another awful joke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You still know how to ask me for what you need. I'll order dessert so we have time.

card.title: Still a Good Sign
card.instruction: Treat every awkward or disappointing interaction as proof that the connection remains alive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've postponed dinner again. You still hate disappointing me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the third time. I feel awful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After three cancellations, my feelings still matter to you. That means something.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Please stop holding Fridays for me. I can't promise anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're protecting my Fridays now. I'll leave the date open; we're already looking after each other.

card.title: Affectionate Resentment
card.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Here's your tea, exactly as you like it. Someone remembers preferences.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Thank you for remembering.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're welcome. The department never closed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are we talking about my forgetting your birthday?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. Your tea would get cold during that annual discussion.

card.title: Affectionate Resentment
card.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've warmed your side of the bed, love. You sounded frozen waiting for that taxi.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could have picked me up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I could. Here's another blanket. I remember waiting outside your office last Christmas.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I apologised. Could you warm my feet?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come here, love. Both feet. I wouldn't leave any part of you waiting forty minutes.

card.title: Relationship Ledger
card.instruction: Price closeness, forgiveness, and support in favors, sacrifices, access, and future loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll let the argument go if you come to my opening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought forgiveness was a gift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It is. I'd like to hand it over beside my paintings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm working that night. I could help hang them on Sunday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hanging buys forgiveness. Stay to take them down and I'll stop mentioning the argument to Mum.

card.title: Relationship Ledger
card.instruction: Price closeness, forgiveness, and support in favors, sacrifices, access, and future loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can have the spare key again for one reliable Sunday visit a month.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're charging rent on closeness.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A very modest calendar-based rate.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could we start with coffee?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Coffee earns a provisional key discussion.

card.title: Closer on My Terms
card.instruction: Agree to repair the relationship while redefining closeness around the boundaries that benefit you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, let's reconnect. I'll come for dinner and leave at ten.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We need to discuss why you left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Put that before pudding so we finish on something nice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if I'm still upset at ten?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll book another dinner. I want us to keep seeing each other without either evening running over.

card.title: Closer on My Terms
card.instruction: Agree to repair the relationship while redefining closeness around the boundaries that benefit you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd love a weekend to patch things up. Separate rooms, though, and no old arguments.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The old arguments are why we need the weekend.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let's start with a pleasant afternoon. We can rebuild from there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't fit everything I need to say into an afternoon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send the rest by email. I'll read it when I'm ready, and we can keep the afternoon for us.

card.title: Here We Go Again
card.instruction: Use every new disagreement to prove the same relationship pattern is repeating, then raise the consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You promised to call. I kept dinner warm until eleven again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: This time my battery died.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Last time it was the train. Different explanation, same ruined dinner. Tomorrow I'm eating at seven.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll borrow a phone next time. Please keep a plate for me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's how I end up waiting again. Miss another call and you're buying and cooking your own dinners.

card.title: Here We Go Again
card.instruction: Use every new disagreement to prove the same relationship pattern is repeating, then raise the consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're cancelling Sunday again? Mum's already made up the spare bed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Work changed my shift. I can't help it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Last time it was overtime. Same empty bed, same explanation from me. You tell her this time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll think I don't want to visit. Could you soften it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the pattern: you cancel, I soften. Now you can arrange the next visit with her too.

card.title: Let Me Lean
card.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you make this one call for me? Just say the booking's cancelled.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What's wrong?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please let the call be the first thing you take off me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Do you want to talk afterward?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Maybe. One thing lighter might make room.

card.title: Let Me Lean
card.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Read the first line of this letter before I do.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Shall I read it aloud?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if your face stays reasonably ordinary.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sit beside you. We can take one line at a time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep hold of the page too. I'll follow your finger. No need to ask why I'm taking so long.

card.title: Stay Until I’m Steady
card.instruction: Keep someone present until you feel steady enough to face what comes next without them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay for one more tea. My hands haven't caught up with the news.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've had three cups.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the fourth needs no explanation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My taxi's outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me manage one quiet minute while it's still only outside.

card.title: Stay Until I’m Steady
card.instruction: Keep someone present until you feel steady enough to face what comes next without them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you leave me in the new flat, count five breaths with me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was five. Shall I close the door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not yet. Five more while I look at the empty kitchen instead of you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll wait here while you put the kettle on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay until it boils. Then I'll try pouring one cup without getting yours out.

card.title: Understand the Hurt
card.instruction: Make someone acknowledge why their action hurt, not merely agree that it happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I saved you a front-row seat at my concert. Do you understand why it hurt?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I told you work might run late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I knew. I still looked at that empty seat before every song.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You needed someone there who knew what this meant to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. You'd heard me practise for months. Please tell me you understand why someone else couldn't fill it.

card.title: Understand the Hurt
card.instruction: Make someone acknowledge why their action hurt, not merely agree that it happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your silence hurt. Not because I needed an instant reply.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My phone died.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I thought our conversation had.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You thought I'd stopped caring?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Please answer that before the battery story.

card.title: Tell Me I Did Enough
card.instruction: Get someone to reassure you that your effort, choice, or survival was enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I only finished one painting. Tell me that counts.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could do more next month.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before next month, could this one be enough for today?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You worked hard on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Let me hear that without an assignment afterward.

card.title: Tell Me I Did Enough
card.instruction: Get someone to reassure you that your effort, choice, or survival was enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I made it through the speech without leaving. Was that enough?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You forgot a paragraph.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know. I'm asking about staying.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You stayed all the way through. I'll help you practise the missing bit tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could staying earn me tomorrow off? Tell me I can put the speech away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please make the cancellation call while I recover from my excellent demonstration of endurance.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can say you're overwhelmed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can say the champion requires one call less.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Would you like me to stay afterwards?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As a fellow professional admiring the recovery, yes. Bring two cups.

bespokePairs.seedUse: A accepts practical support only as recognition of endurance; the request for shared emotional weight is embedded in resisting pity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Read this letter beside me, but keep the sympathetic face for someone less formidable.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're shaking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A formidable amount of anticipation. Start the first line for me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can take it slowly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Frame that as a strategic pace, not a rescue.

bespokePairs.seedUse: A accepts practical support only as recognition of endurance; the request for shared emotional weight is embedded in resisting pity.

card.title: Don’t Pity Me
card.instruction: Frame your struggle as evidence of strength, steering concern toward admiration and rejecting anything that feels like pity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You came to my solo show. Please stop saying 'brave' in that sad voice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Three people walked out. I wanted to buy you a drink.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I finished anyway. You can buy a drink for that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll invite the cast next door. They're celebrating a sellout.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Tell them I finished with no audience at all. Let's see them do that.

card.title: Let Me Lean
card.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you make this one call for me? Just say the booking's cancelled.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What's wrong?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please let the call be the first thing you take off me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Do you want to talk afterward?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Maybe. One thing lighter might make room.

card.title: Don’t Pity Me
card.instruction: Frame your struggle as evidence of strength, steering concern toward admiration and rejecting anything that feels like pity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I carried the entire move myself. Please stop making that poor-you face.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You must be exhausted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Impressively exhausted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I bring you tea?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. In the mug marked champion, not survivor.

card.title: Let Me Lean
card.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Read the first line of this letter before I do.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Shall I read it aloud?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if your face stays reasonably ordinary.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You want me beside you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Let's call that helping with the lighting.
